carouselA.title: How Does a Designer Develop Recognizable Codes?: the institutional sequence

frames.caption: A designer develops recognizable codes by making recurring decisions legible across difference—not by repeating a logo, freezing one silhouette, or declaring an abstract aesthetic owned.
frames.alt: Title plate for How Does a Designer Develop Recognizable Codes?.

frames.caption: 01 · NOTICE — What actually recurs?. Sample complete bodies of work, not isolated hero images. Code observable decisions—proportion, line, volume, material, construction, color, finish, movement, casting, image, language, refusal—and keep fact separate from critical interpretation.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping what actually recurs? within How Does a Designer Develop Recognizable Codes?.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 02 · NAME — Can the decision be described without mystique?. Write each code as a decision with range and rationale: what changes, what stays, what problem it solves, who contributes, and which exception proves that the principle is alive rather than decorative repetition.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping can the decision be described without mystique? within How Does a Designer Develop Recognizable Codes?.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 03 · TEST — Can another person recognize and challenge it?. Use blind comparisons, counterexamples, fittings, material trials, and collaborator critique. Record disagreement. If recognition depends entirely on founder explanation, the code has not yet become shared institutional knowledge.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping can another person recognize and challenge it? within How Does a Designer Develop Recognizable Codes?.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 04 · BOUND — What is cultural signal, and what is a legal asset?. Separate reputation and visual resemblance from exact copyrighted expression, registered marks, design rights, contracts, confidential information, and other evidence. A codebook supports practice; it does not create a monopoly over style.

frames.caption: Codification can turn a living practice into a checklist, reward self-copying, erase collaborators, and encourage overbroad ownership claims. The countermeasure is to document exceptions, disputed authorship, outside influence, community knowledge, failed experiments, and the conditions under which a code should change.
frames.alt: Counterpoint card for How Does a Designer Develop Recognizable Codes?.
frames.treatment: typographic quotation field; no decorative imagery

frames.caption: Write five proposed codes, then attach two counterexamples and one deliberate exception to each.
frames.alt: Fieldwork prompt for How Does a Designer Develop Recognizable Codes?.
